summary: Added a reconfiguration/authority-transition case to the cluster harness and requested its execution: with a four-entry prefix decided, one participant is removed, the leader proposes configuration_id 2, both live participants must report the decided StopSign and reject further proposals, and the absent participant must learn the decided StopSign and catch up after being rebuilt from its persisted storage. The case ran locally with all three properties holding; three comparisons and their admission are declared, and the earlier cases remain in the harness with their comparisons already evaluated in the preceding revision.
